facts.fact: In the vendor's suggested first-90-days plan, the soft launch phase (weeks 3-6) has a budget guide of $300-$600 per month.
facts.quote: Soft launch | 3-6 | One spot, tight zip targeting, steady frequency | $300-$600/month

facts.fact: In the vendor's suggested first-90-days plan, the commit phase (weeks 11-13) has a budget guide of $500-$1,500 per month.
facts.quote: Commit | 11-13 | Settle on sustainable monthly level you can hold for a year | $500-$1,500/month

facts.fact: In the vendor's suggested first-90-days plan, the foundation phase (weeks 1-2) has a $0 budget guide because ad creation is free.
facts.quote: Foundation | 1-2 | Website current, GBP complete, reviews seeded; generate 2 ad variations | $0 (ad creation is free)

facts.fact: The vendor says new businesses can expect recognition signals from TV advertising in 4-8 weeks at steady local frequency.

facts.fact: The vendor says customer-volume effects from TV advertising typically follow in the 90-180 day range.
facts.quote: Customer-volume effects typically follow in the 90-180 day range as awareness converts to trial

facts.fact: The vendor states that most new businesses can clear all four readiness conditions in their first six months.
